Womenswear and Menswear New Arrivals ('les-nouveautes-mode-femme'/'homme') are live-linked in the current desktop megamenu as 'Nouveautés' under their fashion submenus. DROPPED as zero-product: 'nouveautes-linge-de-maison' (title 'Nouveautés - Journée d'été', a 2021-era stale home-linen collection, 0 products confirmed via exhaustive products.json). No other new-arrivals terms (nouveaux produits, derniers arrivages, etc.) found in the full nav/collection scan.
